June, in #strategic-pod I replied in your thread: Gideon closed ticket #8841 with support on 1 Jul at 09:17. He said the fix was clearing a browser cache issue on Vantorre's kiosk tablets, after which the standard template worked for their billing team.

Older digests in the brain describe #8841 as a Newark Door 14 kiosk issue and an Allentown gate kiosk timeout. I used the channel message because it is the direct record, but those digests may be worth checking.
